outcome.answer: Woosung Koh and coauthors introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf) to make continual post-training work better for small models [1]. It uses a minimally larger aligner from the same model family to generate in-distribution rewrites, alongside off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, avoiding the reliance on small models’ weaker in-context learning abilities [1]. The paper reports consistent gains over six methods across three small-model scales, evaluating both learning new capabilities and retaining prior knowledge [1].
